candidates.decision_relevance: Would show whether proxy participation weakness persisted, recovered, or preceded price moves, helping distinguish a short-lived rebound from sustained deterioration.
candidates.evidence_reference: Daily director outputs, 2026-10-22 through 2026-10-23: repeated uncertainties about proxy breadth being point-in-time, changing-membership, and not sequence-aligned; weekly reviews W37–W42 also lack quantitative breadth sequences.
candidates.metric_name: Timestamped proxy breadth counts and constituent returns
candidates.missing_history_problem: Analyses report isolated breadth captures with different membership hashes or retrieval windows. Without a retained time series and membership context, persistence and ordering relative to price weakness cannot be assessed.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would clarify whether spot participation changes persisted alongside price and breadth changes, rather than reflecting brief, potentially divergent snapshots.
candidates.evidence_reference: Daily director outputs, 2026-10-22 through 2026-10-23: spot taker and depth imbalances are repeatedly described as short, venue-specific snapshots with unknown persistence; weekly reviews W36–W42 cite missing spot-participation sequences.
candidates.metric_name: Timestamped venue-specific spot taker and depth imbalance series
candidates.missing_history_problem: The supplied analyses compare isolated snapshots, sometimes with conflicting BTC and ETH readings. A prior time series would reveal duration and sequence without treating snapshots as sustained flow.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would distinguish a one-session flow observation from persistent or reversing settled flows and align flow history with price and participation changes.
candidates.evidence_reference: Daily director outputs, 2026-10-22 through 2026-10-23: ETF evidence is repeatedly limited to one settled session; weekly reviews W35–W42 note absent or insufficiently sequenced settled-flow history.
candidates.metric_name: Daily settled BTC and ETH ETF flow totals
candidates.missing_history_problem: Single-session settled totals cannot establish persistence, within-period direction changes, or whether flows preceded or followed the reported market moves.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would permit descriptive evaluation of the shadow forecast candidates while preserving their original information cutoff and avoiding hindsight leakage.
candidates.evidence_reference: Weekly reviews W39–W42 report missing candidate-linked outcome rows, forecast timestamps, or matured typed outcomes; daily outputs from 2026-10-22 through 2026-10-23 contain unratified candidates but no linked matured results.
candidates.metric_name: Frozen-candidate horizon outcomes linked to issuance timestamps
candidates.missing_history_problem: Candidate definitions and later realized metric paths are not supplied as linked observations, preventing assessment of outcomes at the stated horizons and whether evidence was available at issuance.
